prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1160; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and limited range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces involved in a crash of this type, and the presenting symptoms fit that history. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the knee injury. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body area is known to this provider. Over the course of 25 visits, the patient received physical therapy, anti-inflammatory medication management, and progressive strengthening exercises. The treatment course followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as swelling resolved, strength returned, and function improved. At the time of discharge, the patient had regained most of the motion and stability in the knee and was returning to daily activities. Note that two similar billing entries recorded on the same date of service are currently under administrative review.
